title: Going back to the High Schools: Challenging Stereotypes about Economics
title_zh: 回归高中课堂：挑战对经济学的刻板印象
title_primary: 回归高中课堂：挑战对经济学的刻板印象
title_secondary: Going back to the High Schools: Challenging Stereotypes about Economics
authors: Sarah Smith, Arun Advani, Laura Harvey
official: 官方在线 2025-07-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Students may hold stereotyped beliefs about subjects that distort subject choices. For example, economics is believed to be about money, not inequality or well-being, and this perception may attract some students to the subject, while deterring others. We report results from a UK-wide high school outreach program in which undergraduate champions delivered economics taster sessions to 5,000+ students. The sessions increase students’ reported likelihood of studying economics by ~20 per cent. We shed light on what drives this increase. The sessions broaden students’ understanding of what economics is about and this accounts for ~20 per cent of the increased likelihood. The sessions also change students’ beliefs about (different attributes of) studying economics. The most important drivers of the increased likelihood are students’ increased beliefs that they will do well in economics and that they will enjoy studying the subject.
abstract_zh: 学生可能对学科持有刻板印象，从而扭曲其学科选择。例如，经济学被认为关乎金钱，而非不平等或福祉，这种认知可能吸引部分学生选择该学科，同时阻碍其他学生。我们报告了一项英国全国性高中外展项目的结果，在该项目中，本科生大使为5000多名学生提供了经济学体验课程。这些课程使学生报告的学习经济学可能性增加了约20%。我们揭示了这一增长背后的驱动因素。课程拓宽了学生对经济学内涵的理解，这解释了约20%的可能性增长。课程还改变了学生对学习经济学（不同方面）的信念。可能性增长的最重要驱动因素是学生对自己将在经济学上表现出色以及享受学习该学科的信心增强。

title: Reconfiguring deforestation drivers in Brazil’s Legal Amazon after 2018: Climate, agricultural production, and environmental governance
title_zh: 2018年后巴西亚马逊合法区毁林驱动因素的重构：气候、农业生产与环境治理
title_primary: 2018年后巴西亚马逊合法区毁林驱动因素的重构：气候、农业生产与环境治理
title_secondary: Reconfiguring deforestation drivers in Brazil’s Legal Amazon after 2018: Climate, agricultural production, and environmental governance
authors: Erick Mauricio Corimanya-Yucra, Evandro Mateus Moretto
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Deforestation in Brazil’s Legal Amazon increased sharply after 2018, renewing concerns about environmental governance and frontier expansion. Yet it remains unclear whether this surge reflected only higher forest loss or a deeper reconfiguration of land-use drivers. The study examines whether the relationships linking municipal deforestation to governance, climate, and agricultural expansion changed after 2018. Using a municipality-year panel covering 634 municipalities for 2010–2021, the study combines satellite-based deforestation data, municipal economic accounts, gridded climate indicators, and environmental enforcement records in panel interaction and event-study models, complemented by an aggregate break-date assessment and spatial comparisons between the arc of deforestation and the interior Amazon. The results are consistent with a post-2018 reconfiguration of deforestation dynamics rather than only an increase in forest-loss levels. After 2018, the already positive enforcement–deforestation association strengthened substantially, indicating a change in magnitude rather than a sign reversal. This pattern is consistent with enforcement actions becoming increasingly concentrated in municipalities under greater deforestation pressure. Baseline estimates suggest that precipitation becomes more positively associated with deforestation while temperature loses explanatory relevance. These climatic shifts are sensitive to specifications that absorb time-varying spatial shocks, while the agricultural channel strengthens mainly outside the consolidated frontier. The baseline estimates are also spatially uneven: precipitation is positively associated with deforestation in the arc but negatively associated in the interior. These findings point to a qualitative restructuring of land-use pressures and support policy responses that combine restored enforcement with spatially differentiated governance strategies.
abstract_zh: 巴西亚马逊合法地区的森林砍伐在2018年后急剧增加，重新引发了关于环境治理和边疆扩张的担忧。然而，尚不清楚这一激增是否仅反映了更高的森林损失，还是土地利用驱动因素发生了更深层次的重组。本研究考察了将市级森林砍伐与治理、气候和农业扩张联系起来的关联在2018年后是否发生了变化。利用覆盖2010—2021年634个市镇的市镇—年度面板数据，本研究将基于卫星的森林砍伐数据、市级经济账户、网格化气候指标和环境执法记录相结合，应用于面板交互和事件研究模型中，并辅以总体断点日期评估以及砍伐弧区与亚马逊内陆之间的空间比较。结果与2018年后森林砍伐动态的重组相一致，而非仅仅是森林损失水平的上升。2018年后，原本已为正的执法—森林砍伐关联显著增强，表明变化体现在幅度而非符号反转上。这一模式与执法行动日益集中于面临更大砍伐压力的市镇相一致。基线估计表明，降水与森林砍伐的正向关联增强，而温度的解释相关性减弱。这些气候效应在吸收时变空间冲击的设定下较为敏感，而农业渠道主要在已整合边疆之外得到强化。基线估计在空间上也不均衡：在砍伐弧区，降水与森林砍伐呈正相关，而在内陆地区则呈负相关。这些发现指向土地利用压力的质性重构，并支持将恢复执法与空间差异化治理策略相结合的政策应对。

title: Monetary stabilization of export shocks, revisited
title_zh: 出口冲击的货币稳定化：再探讨
title_primary: 出口冲击的货币稳定化：再探讨
title_secondary: Monetary stabilization of export shocks, revisited
authors: Sushant Acharya, Edouard Challe, Giancarlo Corsetti
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study how monetary policy shapes macroeconomic outcomes in a two-sector small open economy hit by export shocks —due, e.g., to export tariffs, geopolitical tensions, or a recession in destination countries— allowing the shock to have both aggregate and distributional effects. Imperfect worker mobility across sectors, coupled with incomplete markets against aggregate and idiosyncratic shocks, implies that export contractions (i) spill over across sectors due to households’ precautionary response and (ii) affect income and consumption inequalities within and across sectors —in addition to their usual asymmetric effects on sectoral outputs and wages. In this context, exchange-rate flexibility provides insurance against inefficient fluctuations in consumption inequality, which increases the social value of floating-rate regimes. Relative to a nominal exchange-rate peg, flexible inflation targeting helps mitigate the rise in consumption inequality after an export contraction, especially among tradable-sector workers. However, even flexible inflation targeting does not in general provide sufficient exchange-rate flexibility relative to the optimal monetary policy.
abstract_zh: 我们研究货币政策如何在遭受出口冲击（例如，因出口关税、地缘政治紧张局势或目的地国经济衰退所致）的二元部门小型开放经济中塑造宏观经济结果，并允许该冲击同时具有总量效应和分配效应。部门间工人流动性不完善，加之针对总量冲击和异质性冲击的市场不完全性，意味着出口收缩（i）因家庭预防性反应而跨部门溢出，且（ii）除对部门产出和工资产生通常的非对称影响外，还影响部门内及部门间的收入与消费不平等。在此背景下，汇率灵活性为消费不平等的低效波动提供了保险，从而提升了浮动汇率制度的社会价值。相对于名义汇率钉住制度，灵活的通胀目标制有助于缓解出口收缩后消费不平等的加剧，尤其是在可贸易部门工人中。然而，即便采用灵活的通胀目标制，相对于最优货币政策而言，通常也无法提供足够的汇率灵活性。

title: Pandemic disruptions in global supply chains: Evidence on trade values and prices from French firms
title_zh: 全球供应链中的疫情中断：来自法国企业的贸易价值与价格证据
title_primary: 全球供应链中的疫情中断：来自法国企业的贸易价值与价格证据
title_secondary: Pandemic disruptions in global supply chains: Evidence on trade values and prices from French firms
authors: Mariya Brussevich, Chris Papageorgiou, Pauline Wibaux
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines how firms responded to the disruptions caused by the global supply chain (GSC) shocks induced by the COVID‐19 pandemic. Leveraging firm‐level trade data from France, we analyze shifts in export and import values and prices in response to transportation bottlenecks and pandemic containment measures in partner countries. Our findings reveal that firms adapted to these shocks by temporarily scaling back trade volumes and dropping varieties. During the recovery phase, supply chain bottlenecks stoked price hikes, disproportionately affecting upstream industries. Furthermore, we demonstrate that firms using industrial robots in production and those with prudent inventory management practices were more resilient to the pandemic shock.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了企业如何应对由COVID-19疫情引发的全球供应链（GSC）冲击所导致的 disruptions。利用法国企业层面的贸易数据，我们分析了在运输瓶颈及伙伴国疫情管控措施下，出口和进口价值及价格的变动。研究发现，企业通过暂时缩减贸易规模和减少产品种类来适应这些冲击。在复苏阶段，供应链瓶颈加剧了价格上涨，对上游行业影响尤为显著。此外，我们证明，在生产中使用工业机器人的企业以及采取审慎库存管理实践的企业，对疫情冲击表现出更强的韧性。

title: Do Forests Burn Alone? The Role of Wildfire on Fertility in the United States
title_zh: 森林独自燃烧吗？野火对美国生育率的影响
title_primary: 森林独自燃烧吗？野火对美国生育率的影响
title_secondary: Do Forests Burn Alone? The Role of Wildfire on Fertility in the United States
authors: Barai, Dipanwita
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Fertility is a complex amalgamation of human choice, economic conditions, and environmental factors. While the biological toxicity of wildfire-induced air pollution is well-documented to have severe detrimental effects on human health and the reproductive system, reproductive outcomes are not dictated by biology alone. They are profoundly shaped by human behavioral responses. This study analyzes the net effect of wildfire exposure, alongside economic shocks and non-parametric temperature extremes, on fertility in the United States. Utilizing a comprehensive county-monthyear panel dataset from 2010 to 2023, the analysis employs a Poisson Pseudo-Maximum Likelihood (PPML) regression incorporating high-dimensional county and year-month fixed effects. The primary findings reveal a statistically significant positive relationship between wildfire exposure and fertility. Utilizing SafeGraph mobility data, this study empirically isolates the behavioral mechanism driving this result: wildfires cause a highly significant increase in the proportion of the population sheltering completely at home, altering daily routines in a manner that overrides the biological detriments of smoke exposure. Furthermore, a continuous interaction analysis reveals a stark environmental justice divide: while the shelter-in-place "baby bump" occurs universally across income groups, economically vulnerable counties suffer severe fertility depressions from the economic anxiety accompanying disasters, significantly muting the behavioral bump. A 500iteration randomization inference (placebo) test confirms the causal robustness of these findings, yielding an empirical p-value of < 0.01.
abstract_zh: 生育是人类选择、经济状况与环境因素复杂交织的产物。尽管野火引发的空气污染在生物学上的毒性已被充分证实对人类健康及生殖系统具有严重不利影响，但生育结果并非仅由生物学因素决定，而是深受人类行为响应的塑造。本研究分析了野火暴露、经济冲击及非参数化温度极端事件对美国生育率的净效应。利用2010年至2023年间全面的县级-年月面板数据集，分析采用泊松伪极大似然（PPML）回归，并纳入高维县级及年月固定效应。主要发现揭示了野火暴露与生育率之间存在统计上显著的正相关关系。借助SafeGraph流动性数据，本研究实证分离了驱动这一结果的行为机制：野火导致完全居家庇护的人口比例显著增加，从而改变日常作息，其影响超越了烟雾暴露的生物学危害。此外，连续交互分析揭示了鲜明的环境正义鸿沟：尽管居家庇护引发的“婴儿潮”在各收入群体中普遍存在，但经济脆弱县因灾害伴随的经济焦虑而遭受严重的生育率抑制，显著削弱了行为性增长效应。一项500次迭代的随机化推断（安慰剂）检验证实了这些发现的因果稳健性，经验p值小于0.01。

title: Cognitive Limitations and Long-Term Care Use in the Netherlands: Evidence from the Lifelines Cohort Study
title_zh: 认知限制与荷兰长期照护使用：来自生命线队列研究的证据
title_primary: 认知限制与荷兰长期照护使用：来自生命线队列研究的证据
title_secondary: Cognitive Limitations and Long-Term Care Use in the Netherlands: Evidence from the Lifelines Cohort Study
authors: Gaia Bagnasco, Pieter Bakx, Stijn Coremans, Bram Wouterse
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We analyze the association between cognitive impairments and long-term care use in the 65+ population in the Netherlands. For this, we use data from the Lifelines Cohort Study that are linked to administrative records available through Statistics Netherlands. We find that, among those with cognitive impairments, long-term care use is concentrated in a subgroup: 42% of those with cognitive impairments do not use any long-term care. At the same time, individuals with cognitive impairments who use long-term care have high expenditures, in particular when living in nursing homes. Further analyses reveal that many individuals with cognitive impairments report functional limitations and that cognitive impairment is associated with long-term care use above and beyond these impairments. These findings highlight the importance of taking cognitive impairments into account when seeking to explain the determinants of long-term care use in research and when tailoring long-term care programs to the needs of the elderly when considering policy reforms.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了荷兰65岁及以上人群中认知障碍与长期护理使用之间的关联。为此，我们利用了Lifelines队列研究的数据，这些数据与荷兰统计局提供的行政记录相链接。我们发现，在认知障碍患者中，长期护理的使用集中于一个亚群：42%的认知障碍患者未使用任何长期护理。同时，使用长期护理的认知障碍个体支出较高，尤其是在养老院居住时。进一步分析显示，许多认知障碍个体报告存在功能限制，且认知障碍与长期护理使用之间的关联超出了这些功能限制的影响。这些发现强调了在研究中解释长期护理使用决定因素时考虑认知障碍的重要性，以及在政策改革中根据老年人需求定制长期护理计划时的重要性。

title: The role of information in eliciting support for inheritance taxation: experimental evidence from Luxembourg
title_zh: 信息在激发对遗产税支持中的作用：来自卢森堡的实验证据
title_primary: 信息在激发对遗产税支持中的作用：来自卢森堡的实验证据
title_secondary: The role of information in eliciting support for inheritance taxation: experimental evidence from Luxembourg
authors: Javier Olivera, Erik Schokkaert, Philippe Van Kerm
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper uses a survey experiment embedded in the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement (SHARE) for Luxembourg – a representative sample of the population aged 50 and above in the country – to show how provision of information influences elicited support for inheritance taxation. While support is low in generic, direct questions about inheritance taxation, support increases when respondents are asked to express views about linear tax rates with explicit tax exemption thresholds and when information is provided about how tax revenues will be used – especially if respondents are told revenues will be used to improve the quality of basic education. This information effect acts even in a setting in which the focus is on inheritances from parents to children and in a country with low inheritance taxation. The effect is however only relevant for respondents who are initially opposed to a tax.
abstract_zh: 本文利用嵌入卢森堡健康、老龄化与退休调查（SHARE）中的一项实验性调查——该调查为该国50岁及以上人口的代表性样本——揭示了信息提供如何影响受访者对遗产税的支持度。在关于遗产税的通用直接问题中，支持度较低；但当受访者被要求对具有明确免税门槛的线性税率表达看法，并被告知税收收入将用于改善基础教育质量时，支持度显著上升。即便在关注父母向子女继承遗产的情境下，以及遗产税税率较低的国家中，这一信息效应依然存在。然而，该效应仅对最初反对遗产税的受访者具有显著影响。

title: Threshold endogeneity in vector autoregressions: reassessing monetary state dependence
title_zh: 向量自回归中的阈值内生性：重新评估货币状态依赖性
title_primary: 向量自回归中的阈值内生性：重新评估货币状态依赖性
title_secondary: Threshold endogeneity in vector autoregressions: reassessing monetary state dependence
authors: Christopoulos, Dimitris & McAdam, Peter & Tzavalis, Elias
official: 官方在线 2026-01-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop an endogenous threshold VAR that addresses contemporaneous dependence between the threshold variable and reduced-form innovations— a pervasive issue when regime indicators are jointly determined with system dynamics. A regime-specific copula-based control function removes this dependence instrument-free, without parametric assumptions on the threshold’s marginal distribution, while preserving the linear regime-wise least-squares structure. We characterize the resulting misspecification through excess sensitivity and excess propagation errors in impulse responses, clarify structural and proxy-SVAR identification under endogenous regimes, and establish conditions under which Chan-type threshold asymptotics remain valid with generated controls. A Hermite sieve extension accommodates tail-dependent and asymmetric dependence. Monte Carlo evidence documents large distortions from ignoring endogeneity. Applied to monetary transmission, the framework avoids the price and persistence puzzles displayed by the linear VAR, delivers regime-dependent sacrifice ratios, and aligns estimated regimes with historical inflation episodes. JEL Classification: C32, C34, E52
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个内生阈值向量自回归模型，该模型解决了阈值变量与简化形式新息之间的同期依赖问题——当体制指标与系统动态共同决定时，这是一个普遍存在的难题。通过采用基于体制特定连接函数的控制函数，我们无需工具变量即可消除这种依赖，无需对阈值的边际分布施加参数假设，同时保留了线性体制最小二乘结构。我们通过脉冲响应中的过度敏感性和过度传播误差来刻画由此产生的设定偏误，阐明了内生体制下的结构识别与代理SVAR识别，并建立了在生成控制变量条件下陈氏阈值渐近性质保持有效的条件。埃尔米特样条扩展方法可处理尾部依赖与非对称依赖。蒙特卡洛证据表明，忽略内生性会导致严重偏差。在货币政策传导的应用中，该框架避免了线性VAR模型呈现的价格谜题与持续性谜题，提供了依赖体制的牺牲比率，并使估计的体制与历史通胀阶段保持一致。JEL分类号：C32, C34, E52

title: Equity as Tribute: The Market for Passive State Equity
title_zh: 被动国家股权的市场：作为贡品的股权
title_primary: 被动国家股权的市场：作为贡品的股权
title_secondary: Equity as Tribute: The Market for Passive State Equity
authors: Joshua S. Gans
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Firms have begun granting passive equity stakes to the government that regulates them. The received reading is “skin in the game:” ownership moves profits onto the treasury's balance sheet, so policy softens. We show that once the price of the stake and the firm's policy exposure are determined in equilibrium, the owners' consent reveals nothing about whether they benefit. Sellers capitalise the induced policy improvement into the price, so an anticipated purchase can only occur at a discount; a government with bargaining power pays zero for a sufficiently exposed firm; and a government that can first raise exposure manufactures precisely enough of it to drive the negotiated price to its legal floor. Equity becomes tribute. Prohibition is nonetheless dominated: at fixed exposure, a passive stake corrects the political underweighting of shareholders. Welfare is maximised by priced permission—an ownership cap at the fixed-exposure optimum and a per-unit price floor equal to baseline no-stake value. The floor, unlike the cap, requires no knowledge of the government's political weights.
abstract_zh: 企业开始向监管自身的政府授予被动股权。现有解读将其视为“利益捆绑”：所有权将利润纳入政府资产负债表，从而软化政策。我们证明，一旦股权价格与企业的政策敞口在均衡中确定，所有者的同意并不能揭示其是否获益。卖方将政策改善的预期收益资本化至价格中，因此预期收购仅能以折价发生；具备议价能力的政府为零成本获取充分暴露的企业；而能先行提升政策敞口的政府，会精确制造足够敞口，将协商价格压低至法定下限。股权由此沦为贡金。然而，禁止此类行为并非最优：在固定敞口下，被动股权纠正了股东在政治权重中的低估。福利最大化可通过定价许可实现——即设定固定敞口最优水平的所有权上限，以及等于无股权基准价值的单位价格下限。与上限不同，下限无需知晓政府的政治权重。

title: Financial suicide: Debt and death across US counties during the Great Recession
title_zh: 金融自杀：大衰退期间美国各县的债务与死亡
title_primary: 金融自杀：大衰退期间美国各县的债务与死亡
title_secondary: Financial suicide: Debt and death across US counties during the Great Recession
authors: Scott Abrahams, Bulent Unel
official: 官方在线 2026-07-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Exploiting variation in debt‐to‐income ratios across US counties at the onset of the Great Recession, we investigate the impact of debt exposure on suicide. We find that more indebted counties saw a significant rise in suicide rates, with effects double for men and triple among adults ages 40–64. These patterns align with financial responsibilities: men are primary borrowers on mortgages, and middle‐aged adults hold the most secured debt. The impact of debt on suicide behavior, with annual costs of several billion dollars, underscores the welfare implications of inflexible household debt instruments.
abstract_zh: 利用大衰退初期美国各县债务收入比的变化，我们研究了债务暴露对自杀行为的影响。研究发现，债务负担更重的县自杀率显著上升，其中男性自杀率增幅为女性两倍，40-64岁成年人自杀率增幅为其他年龄段三倍。这些模式与财务责任分布高度吻合：男性是抵押贷款的主要借款人，而中年人持有最多担保债务。债务对自杀行为的影响——每年造成数十亿美元的社会成本——凸显了缺乏灵活性的家庭债务工具对福利的深远影响。

title: Hyperinflation and Stabilization: Cagan Revisited
title_zh: 恶性通货膨胀与稳定：卡甘再探
title_primary: 恶性通货膨胀与稳定：卡甘再探
title_secondary: Hyperinflation and Stabilization: Cagan Revisited
authors: Marcus Miller
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Using a variant of the Cagan model with rational expectations, this paper shows that expected stabilization can result in a budget deficit in excess of the maximum inflation tax. A cap on the deficit dampens inflation expectations and raises real balances, thus increasing the yield of the inflation tax for any given rate of inflation. This study extends the work of Drazen and Helpman (1990) by including a stochastic budgetary process and using option pricing theory. It uses parameter values of the semi-elasticity of demand for money to provide estimates of the maximum viable real deficit.
abstract_zh: 本文采用带有理性预期的卡甘模型变体，论证了预期稳定化可能导致预算赤字超过最大通胀税。赤字上限抑制了通胀预期并提高了实际货币余额，从而在给定通胀率下增加了通胀税的收益。本研究通过引入随机预算过程并运用期权定价理论，拓展了德拉曾与赫尔普曼（1990）的研究成果。基于货币需求半弹性参数值，本文提供了最大可行实际赤字的估算值。

title: What is Newsworthy? Theory and Evidence
title_zh: 什么是值得报道的新闻？理论与证据
title_primary: 什么是值得报道的新闻？理论与证据
title_secondary: What is Newsworthy? Theory and Evidence
authors: Armona, Luis, Gentzkow, Matthew, Kamenica, Emir, Shapiro, Jesse M.
official: 卷期日期 2026-09-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We introduce a model in which a benevolent news outlet decides whether to report the realization of a state to a consumer, who pays a cost to receive it. A simple statistical rule, called a proper scoring rule, describes when the outlet should be more likely to report the realization. Using data from the US television news, we show that a particular scoring rule successfully predicts many salient features of news reporting. We show how to use this rule as a control variable to discipline tests of reporting bias, and we show that controlling for it matters in our applications.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，其中一家秉持善意的新闻机构决定是否向消费者报告某一状态的实现情况，而消费者需为此支付接收成本。一种被称为"恰当评分规则"的简单统计准则，描述了新闻机构在何种情况下更可能报告该实现结果。基于美国电视新闻数据，我们证明该特定评分规则能够成功预测新闻报道的诸多显著特征。我们展示了如何将该规则作为控制变量来约束报道偏误检验，并证实了在应用场景中控制该变量的重要性。

title: Digital enabler or carbon culprit? The U-shaped trajectory of digital innovation on carbon emissions
title_zh: 数字赋能还是碳排元凶？数字创新对碳排放的U型轨迹
title_primary: 数字赋能还是碳排元凶？数字创新对碳排放的U型轨迹
title_secondary: Digital enabler or carbon culprit? The U-shaped trajectory of digital innovation on carbon emissions
authors: Xin Gao, Xuanzhi Yang, Feifei Li, Ruochen Zeng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: While digital innovation (DI) is viewed as a key driver of industrial decarbonization, its environmental impact remains contested. The growing energy demand may induce Jevons-type rebound effects, challenging the sustainability of digital transition. Moving beyond linear and static perspectives, this study integrates dynamic capability theory with the technique-composition-scale framework to examine the nonlinear relationship between DI and carbon emissions (CE). Using panel data from Chinese A-share listed manufacturing firms from 2014 to 2021, the results reveal a robust U-shaped relationship: DI reduces CE in the early stage but increases it after further expansion. This pattern is more pronounced among younger firms and firms in low-energy-intensity sectors. External environmental regulation intensity steepens the curve by accelerating stage transitions, whereas corporate green investment scale acts as an internal buffer, flattening the curve and marginally shifting the turning point rightward. These findings provide stage-adaptive implications for balancing digital transformation with carbon reduction.
abstract_zh: 尽管数字创新被视为工业脱碳的关键驱动力，但其环境影响仍存在争议。日益增长的能源需求可能引发杰文斯型反弹效应，对数字转型的可持续性构成挑战。本研究突破线性与静态视角，将动态能力理论与技术-构成-规模框架相结合，考察数字创新与碳排放之间的非线性关系。基于2014-2021年中国A股制造业上市公司面板数据，结果揭示出稳健的U型关系：数字创新在初期阶段降低碳排放，但进一步扩张后反而增加碳排放。这一模式在年轻企业及低能源强度行业的企业中更为显著。外部环境规制强度通过加速阶段转换使曲线更陡峭，而企业绿色投资规模作为内部缓冲机制则使曲线趋于平缓，并将拐点轻微右移。这些发现为平衡数字化转型与碳减排提供了阶段适应性启示。

title: Financial literacy, financial vulnerability, and buy now, pay later use
title_zh: 金融素养、财务脆弱性与先买后付使用
title_primary: 金融素养、财务脆弱性与先买后付使用
title_secondary: Financial literacy, financial vulnerability, and buy now, pay later use
authors: Miao Wang, M.C. Sunny Wong
official: 来源期次 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using data from the 2024 U.S. National Financial Capability Study, this paper examines the association between financial literacy and buy now, pay later (BNPL) use. A simple framework predicts that greater financial literacy is associated with lower BNPL use, but this link weakens when financial constraints bind. Consistent with this prediction, we find an overall negative association between financial literacy and BNPL use. That pattern, however, is concentrated among non-vulnerable households and becomes weaker, disappears, or reverses under financial vulnerability.
abstract_zh: 利用2024年美国国家金融能力研究数据，本文考察了金融素养与先买后付（BNPL）使用之间的关联。一个简单框架预测，金融素养越高，BNPL使用率越低，但这一联系在财务约束趋紧时会减弱。与这一预测一致，我们发现金融素养与BNPL使用之间存在总体负相关。然而，这一模式集中在非脆弱家庭中，在财务脆弱性下会减弱、消失甚至逆转。

title: Irrigation and Climate Change: Long-Run Adaptation and Its Externalities
title_zh: 灌溉与气候变化：长期适应及其外部性
title_primary: 灌溉与气候变化：长期适应及其外部性
title_secondary: Irrigation and Climate Change: Long-Run Adaptation and Its Externalities
authors: Charles A. Taylor
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: As the largest user of global water, irrigated agriculture accounts for 20% of global cropland and 40% of food production. Irrigation is also a potential adaptive response to drought and extreme temperatures. This paper examines the extent to which the current global irrigation footprint reflects climate change over the last 50 years. Utilizing exogenous variation in geological structure, I find evidence that farmers adapt by increasing groundwater irrigation in places that became dryer and hotter. The results hold globally and in the US. Observed recent warming is responsible for 9% of global irrigation growth. GRACE satellite data shows that climate-driven irrigation contributes to aquifer stress, as well as increased soil salinity, thus representing large negative externalities of adaptation to climate change and a potential threat to future food security. ∗I would like to thank Wolfram Schlenker, Frances Moore, Douglas Almond, Jaime Mullins, Geoffrey Heal, Pierre Gentine, Thomas Braun, and Jeffrey Shrader for their comments, as well as participants at the AERE@EEA conference, WEAI conference, and Climate Economics Workshop at UC Berkeley. †School of International and Public Affairs and The Earth Institute, Columbia University. cat2180@columbia.edu
abstract_zh: 作为全球最大的水资源使用者，灌溉农业占据了全球耕地的20%和粮食产量的40%。灌溉也是对干旱和极端温度的一种潜在适应性响应。本文考察了当前全球灌溉足迹在多大程度上反映了过去50年的气候变化。利用地质构造的外生变异，我发现了农民通过在地势更干燥、温度更高的地区增加地下水灌溉来适应气候变化的证据。这一结果在全球范围内以及美国均成立。观测到的近期变暖现象导致了全球灌溉增长的9%。GRACE卫星数据显示，气候驱动的灌溉加剧了含水层压力，并增加了土壤盐碱度，从而代表了适应气候变化带来的巨大负面外部性，以及对未来粮食安全的潜在威胁。

title: MCA: High-dimensional modal component analysis towards the mode
title_zh: MCA：面向模态的高维模态成分分析
title_primary: MCA：面向模态的高维模态成分分析
title_secondary: MCA: High-dimensional modal component analysis towards the mode
authors: Zhe Sun, Yundong Tu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The modal factor model represents a novel statistical framework for dimension reduction in high dimensional panel data analysis. It is specifically designed to capture modal factors which exert a significant influence on the conditional mode of the distribution of the observables. Statistical inference for this model is developed based on a newly proposed modal component analysis, where modal factors and their corresponding loadings are estimated through maximizing a kernel-type objective function. Two computationally efficient and easy-to-implement algorithms—minorization-maximization and alternating maximization—are devised for the numerical computation of these estimators. Furthermore, two model selection criteria are proposed to determine the optimal number of modal factors. Under mild regularity conditions that accommodate both cross-sectional and time-series dependence, the asymptotic properties of the proposed estimators are established. Additionally, the limiting distributions of parameter estimators and forecasts derived from factor-augmented regressions incorporating estimated modal factors are rigorously derived. Simulation studies demonstrate that the proposed estimators exhibit favorable finite-sample performance, even in the presence of heavy-tailed, skewed, multimodal, and heteroskedastic error distributions. Finally, an application to inflation and industrial production index forecasting validates the practical merits and superior predictive power of modal factors in real-world macroeconomic scenarios.
abstract_zh: 模态因子模型代表了一种新颖的统计框架，用于高维面板数据分析中的降维处理。它专门设计用于捕捉对观测变量分布条件众数具有显著影响的模态因子。基于新提出的模态成分分析，该模型的统计推断得以发展，其中模态因子及其相应的载荷通过最大化核型目标函数来估计。为了这些估计量的数值计算，设计了两种计算高效且易于实现的算法——最小化-最大化算法和交替最大化算法。此外，提出了两种模型选择准则以确定最优模态因子数量。在适应横截面和时间序列依赖性的温和正则条件下，建立了所提估计量的渐近性质。同时，严格推导了包含估计模态因子的因子增强回归中参数估计量及预测的极限分布。模拟研究表明，即使在存在重尾、偏斜、多峰及异方差误差分布的情况下，所提估计量也展现出良好的有限样本性能。最后，应用于通货膨胀和工业生产指数预测的实例验证了模态因子在现实宏观经济情景中的实用价值及优越的预测能力。

title: Scorched Beginnings: Early-Life Heat Exposure and Learning Achievement in India
title_zh: 焦灼起点：印度早期热暴露与学业成就
title_primary: 焦灼起点：印度早期热暴露与学业成就
title_secondary: Scorched Beginnings: Early-Life Heat Exposure and Learning Achievement in India
authors: Mustafi, Sourish, Roychowdhury, Punarjit
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines the effects of early-life exposure to extreme heat on children's learning achievement in India. Exploiting within-district, across-cohort variation in early-life temperature exposure, we find that greater exposure to extreme heat significantly reduces reading, writing, and mathematics achievement in later childhood. These findings remain robust across a battery of robustness checks. We further show that early-life heat exposure adversely affects children's physical development, especially among children from households with limited coping capacity and those exposed to poorer disease environments, suggesting these channels play an important role in shaping later learning achievement. Finally, projections based on future climate scenarios indicate that continued warming is likely to exacerbate human capital losses in India. These findings highlight the persistent influence of early-life climate conditions on human capital formation and underscore the importance of incorporating climate resilience into education and early childhood policy in low- and middle-income countries.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了印度儿童早期极端高温暴露对学业成就的影响。利用同一地区不同出生队列在早期温度暴露上的差异，我们发现极端高温暴露显著降低了儿童后期的阅读、写作和数学成绩。这一发现在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。进一步研究表明，早期高温暴露对儿童身体发育产生不利影响，尤其是在应对能力有限的家庭以及疾病环境较差的儿童中更为显著，这表明这些渠道在塑造后期学业成就方面发挥了重要作用。最后，基于未来气候情景的预测显示，持续变暖可能会加剧印度的人力资本损失。这些发现突显了早期气候条件对人力资本形成的持久影响，并强调了在中低收入国家将气候适应能力纳入教育和儿童早期政策的重要性。

title: Military Presence and Risk Mitigation: The Impact of U.S. Overseas Deployments on Chinese Firms' Foreign Direct Investment
title_zh: 军事存在与风险缓解：美国海外部署对中国企业对外直接投资的影响
title_primary: 军事存在与风险缓解：美国海外部署对中国企业对外直接投资的影响
title_secondary: Military Presence and Risk Mitigation: The Impact of U.S. Overseas Deployments on Chinese Firms' Foreign Direct Investment
authors: Jianguo Xie, Junhao Zhao, Guoqiang Cao
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: U.S. overseas military deployments, as a strategic instrument for maintaining hegemony, structurally reconfigure international capital flows through a security‐economy nexus. While prior studies focus on host‐country perspectives, the third‐party economic spillovers of such deployments remain underexplored. This study investigates how they affect Chinese multinationals' foreign direct investment. The findings reveal a significant negative impact of U.S. military presence on Chinese FDI in host countries. Mechanism tests identify two channels: (1) institutional erosion—U.S. security patronage undermines host‐state governance, elevating political risk premiums that deter Chinese investment; (2) strategic anchoring—military presence strains host countries' relations with China, coupled with deep U.S. economic entrenchment, crowds out Chinese capital through both political and market channels. Heterogeneity analysis reinforces this logic. At the micro level, U.S. deployments heighten Chinese managers' perception of geopolitical risk, reshaping their attention allocation and subsequent investment decisions. These findings suggest that U.S. military retrenchment may reshape the strategic calculus of China's outward investment. By extending traditional FDI risk theory, this paper contributes to a nuanced understanding of the spillover effects of U.S. foreign military strategy amid great‐power competition, offering critical insights into the strategic value of the Belt and Road Initiative and guidance for Chinese firms seeking to reposition their global investment footprint.
abstract_zh: 美国海外军事部署作为维护霸权的战略工具，通过安全-经济联动机制结构性重塑国际资本流动。现有研究多聚焦东道国视角，但此类部署的第三方经济溢出效应仍待深入探究。本文考察美国军事部署如何影响中国跨国企业对外直接投资，发现美国军事存在显著抑制中国对东道国的直接投资。机制检验识别出两条传导路径：（1）制度侵蚀效应——美国安全庇护削弱东道国治理能力，抬升政治风险溢价，抑制中国投资；（2）战略锚定效应——军事部署加剧东道国对华关系紧张，叠加美国深度经济嵌入，通过政治与市场双重渠道挤出中国资本。异质性分析进一步印证该逻辑。微观层面，美国军事部署强化中国管理者对地缘政治风险的感知，重塑其注意力配置与后续投资决策。研究表明，美国军事收缩可能重构中国对外投资的战略考量。本文通过拓展传统FDI风险理论，为理解大国竞争背景下美国海外军事战略的溢出效应提供新视角，同时揭示"一带一路"倡议的战略价值，为中国企业优化全球投资布局提供决策参考。

title: School Construction and Intergenerational Human Capital
title_zh: 学校建设与代际人力资本
title_primary: 学校建设与代际人力资本
title_secondary: School Construction and Intergenerational Human Capital
authors: Naveen Sunder, So Yoon Ahn, Yu Kyung Koh
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper estimates the direct and intergenerational effects of one of the world’s largest school expansion policies. Starting in 1993-94, the District Primary Education Programme (DPEP) constructed over 100,000 new schools and served over 50 million children in India. Using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design I show that the policy increased enrollment, literacy and years of education for both male and female direct beneficiaries. Further, I find that children whose mothers were DPEP beneficiaries had higher scores on vernacular (18 percent), math (13 percent), and English (15 percent) tests, while Father’s DPEP exposure had no effect on children’s learning.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了全球规模最大的学校扩张政策之一的直接效应与代际效应。自1993-94年起，地区初等教育计划（DPEP）在印度新建了超过10万所学校，惠及逾5000万儿童。利用模糊断点回归设计，我发现该政策提高了直接受益男性和女性的入学率、识字率及受教育年限。此外，研究显示，母亲为DPEP受益者的儿童在方言（18%）、数学（13%）和英语（15%）测试中得分更高，而父亲接触DPEP对儿童学习无显著影响。

title: Linking Social and Personal Preferences: Theory and Experiment
title_zh: 连接社会偏好与个人偏好：理论与实验
title_primary: 连接社会偏好与个人偏好：理论与实验
title_secondary: Linking Social and Personal Preferences: Theory and Experiment
authors: William R. Zame, Bertil Tungodden, Erik Ø. Sørensen, Shachar Kariv, Alexander W. Cappelen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The goal of this paper is to link attitude toward risk over personal consumption with attitude toward risk over social consumptions. Because many everyday choices involve risk, these attitudes enter virtually every realm of individual decision-making. We provide necessary and sufficient conditions for deducing preferences over risky social choices (which have consequences both for the Decision Maker and for others) from risky personal choices (which have consequences only for the Decision Maker) and riskless social choices, and we offer an experimental test of the theory. The experiments generate a rich dataset that enables completely non-parametric revealed preference tests of the theory at the level of the individual subject. Many subjects behave as predicted by the theory but a substantial fraction do not. JEL Classification Numbers: C91, D63, D81.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在将个人消费风险态度与社会消费风险态度联系起来。由于众多日常选择涉及风险，这些态度几乎渗透到个体决策的各个领域。我们提供了必要且充分的条件，用以从个人风险选择（仅对决策者自身产生影响）及无风险社会选择中，推导出对风险性社会选择（对决策者及他人均产生影响）的偏好，并对该理论进行了实验检验。实验产生了丰富的数据集，使得能够在个体受试者层面进行完全非参数化的显示性偏好检验。许多受试者的行为符合理论预测，但相当一部分并非如此。JEL分类号：C91, D63, D81。

title: Inheritance, entrepreneurship, and estate taxation
title_zh: 遗产、创业与遗产税
title_primary: 遗产、创业与遗产税
title_secondary: Inheritance, entrepreneurship, and estate taxation
authors: Yanran Guo
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies the joint roles of inheritance and entrepreneurship in shaping wealth inequality using a heterogeneous agent, general equilibrium overlapping generations model. The analysis is disciplined by new empirical evidence from the Survey of Consumer Finances on how inheritances relate to observed wealth among very wealthy households. In the data, among households in the richest 1% of the wealth distribution, only about 6% have received inheritances that account for at least half of their net worth, and more than half report receiving no inheritance at all. When disciplined by these facts, the calibrated model implies that inheritances play only a limited role in generating extreme wealth, even when accounting for their interaction with entrepreneurship. Using the calibrated model, the paper evaluates estate tax reforms and finds that their effects on wealth concentration are smaller than commonly believed.
abstract_zh: 本文通过构建一个包含异质性主体、一般均衡重叠世代模型，研究了继承与创业在塑造财富不平等中的联合作用。分析受到消费者金融调查中关于继承与极富裕家庭观测财富关系的新经验证据的约束。数据显示，在财富分布最富有的1%家庭中，仅有约6%的家庭所获继承至少占其净资产的一半，而超过一半的家庭报告未收到任何继承。在这些事实约束下，校准模型表明，即使考虑到继承与创业的相互作用，继承在产生极端财富方面的作用也有限。利用校准模型，本文评估了遗产税改革，发现其对财富集中度的影响小于普遍认知。

title: Dirty air and green investments: The impact of pollution information on portfolio allocations
title_zh: 污浊空气与绿色投资：污染信息对资产配置的影响
title_primary: 污浊空气与绿色投资：污染信息对资产配置的影响
title_secondary: Dirty air and green investments: The impact of pollution information on portfolio allocations
authors: Raymond Fisman, Pulak Ghosh, Arkodipta Sarkar, Jian Zhang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study whether access to local pollution information causes investors to make greener portfolio allocations, exploiting the rollout of air quality monitoring stations in India. Using a triple-differences framework on the trading records of 19 million investors, we show that retail investors’ holdings in “brown” stocks become more negatively related to local pollution after a nearby station appears. This effect is more pronounced on “alert” dates when air quality is reported to be harmful. The effect is strongest among tech-savvy investors likely “treated” by real-time pollution data, and younger investors, who may be more sensitive to environmental concerns.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了获取本地污染信息是否促使投资者做出更环保的投资组合配置，利用印度空气质量监测站的推广作为自然实验。基于1900万投资者的交易记录，采用三重差分框架，我们发现，在附近监测站设立后，零售投资者对“棕色”股票的持有与本地污染之间的负相关性增强。这一效应在报告空气质量为有害的“警报”日期更为显著。在可能受实时污染数据“影响”的技术娴熟投资者及可能对环境问题更为敏感的年轻投资者中，该效应最为突出。

title: The public cost of Minor League Baseball stadium subsidies
title_zh: 小联盟棒球场补贴的公共成本
title_primary: 小联盟棒球场补贴的公共成本
title_secondary: The public cost of Minor League Baseball stadium subsidies
authors: John Charles Bradbury
official: 官方在线 2026-04-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Public financing of major league sports venues has been widely studied, but government support for minor league facilities has not been systematically documented. This study introduces a new database of Minor League Baseball stadium funding to measure the prevalence and magnitude of subsidies. State and local governments have spent $7 billion constructing and renovating 134 minor league ballparks for Major League Baseball (MLB) affiliates, raising important policy implications for moderately sized municipalities. Using MLB's reorganization of its minor leagues as a natural experiment, the analysis finds no income differences between cities that lost or retained teams, undermining the economic rationale for taxpayer subsidization.
abstract_zh: 职业大联盟体育场馆的公共融资问题已被广泛研究，但政府对小联盟设施的支持尚未得到系统记录。本研究引入了一个新的小联盟棒球场融资数据库，以衡量补贴的普遍性和规模。州及地方政府已为美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）附属球队的134个小联盟球场建设与翻新投入了70亿美元，这对中等规模城市产生了重要的政策启示。利用MLB对小联盟的重组作为自然实验，分析发现失去或保留球队的城市之间并无收入差异，这削弱了纳税人补贴的经济合理性。
